findings.value: A large canalside warehouse bar and kitchen in Hackney Wick, with two club rooms, a 30-foot canal boat bar and a terrace on the canal. Time Out says its live music and club nights run through the year, and the space is also hired out for weddings and corporate events.

evidence.quote: No90 Hideout and No90 Live, the two club spaces
The Mary Read Boat @No90, a 30-foot canal boat with a bar, AV and DJ decks
used for live music and club events year round
perfect for weddings, corporate functions, art exhibitions, and live performances
we have labels and collectives that showcase world music, jazz, house, disco, funk, soul and hip-hop

findings.value: Weekly DJ sets and live performances from resident labels and collectives, plus club nights and live music across its rooms through the year.
